title: Asset and Ghost
author: Lena Reyes
blurb: Yara Hartwell, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
